liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (1 review): Listener recalls this as the best Truckin' performance they have ever witnessed [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-07-09.142466.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 171 min [1]
- **gd1989-07-09.sbd.miller.81177.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4.75/5 by 12 [2]
- **gd1989-07-09.142610.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1989-07-09.142581.sbd.miller.fixed.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd89-07-09.bertha.6943.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4.2/5 by 30 [11]. Said about its sound: Recording is very clear with good range, though slightly bright and tinny [22]

## Around the show

- Front floor fans shouted for Jack Straw, prompting Phil to smile and nod [20]
- Audience created a sign for the fifth anniversary of the last Dark Star [21]
- Thousands of fans slid down stadium walls to the floor during Shakedown Street [23]
- Crowd members leapt down spiral walkways to reach the floor as Shakedown began [24]
- Audience chanted Not Fade Away while leaving the venue at the end [24]
- Buffalo DVD is considered the best sounding release compared to the Alpine version [26]
- Summer 1989 tour is viewed as the best of the decade, with strong July shows [26]
- Buffalo DVD offers the best sound quality among any DVD releases of this era [29]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-07-09.142466.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK2S mics spaced on stands, OTS > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat… [1]
- **gd1989-07-09.sbd.miller.81177.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) D [2]. Also: FOB AKG 414TL to Dat supplies Brokedown Palace patch from 4:28 to the end [2]
- **gd1989-07-09.142610.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [3]. Also: Dan Tepper provided the patch source to fix a tape flip in Victim Or The Crime [3]
- **gd1989-07-09.142581.sbd.miller.fixed.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [4]. Also: Dan Tepper supplied the patch source used to clean up the tape flip in Victim [4]
- **gd89-07-09.bertha.6943.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD (FOB/ AKG414TL)>> ???>> SHN>> Dual DAW (Bertha)>> CDA [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by gripsweat.com: [Gripsweat - GRATEFUL DEAD Giants Stadium 1987, 1989, 1991 Boxed Set - BRAND NEW Blu ray](https://gripsweat.com/item/174054755144/grateful-dead-giants-stadium-1987-1989-1991-boxed-set-brand-newblu-ray) [33]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-07-09 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-07-09-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [34]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - July 9, 1989](https://www.dead.net/show/july-9-1989) [35]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - Giants Stadium 1989-07-09 …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/48766403138/) [36]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/48766403138/) [37]
